item.adaptionwheel.mahoraga_wheel.toolti: The wheel adapts to all phenomena.
The longer you face something, the more you resist it.
Equip it in a Curios charm slot.
adaptionwheel.sword.positive_info: [Positive Energy] Melee hits gain bonus damage based on the target's current HP.
adaptionwheel.sword.cursed_info: [Cursed Energy] Swings fire piercing cursed slashes, empowered by adaptation count.
adaptionwheel.msg.all_adaption_no_wheel: You must equip the Mahoraga Wheel to use this!
adaptionwheel.msg.existence: You have adapted to the existence of %s
adaptionwheel.msg.existence_details: Contact and offense adaptations for this boss set to maximum. Full immunity granted.
adaptionwheel.gui.title: Wheel of Adaptation
adaptionwheel.gui.empty: No adaptations yet. Face the world - the wheel is watching.
adaptionwheel.gui.footer_scroll: Scroll to browse | Click a category to filter
adaptionwheel.desc.Move_SoulSand: Soul sand and soul soil no longer slow your steps.
adaptionwheel.desc.Move_Honey: Honey blocks neither slow you nor dampen your jumps.
adaptionwheel.desc.Move_PowderSnow: You walk atop powder snow and it no longer swallows you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Move_BerryBush: Sweet berry bushes neither snag nor cut you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Move_BubbleColumn: Bubble columns cannot drag you down or hurl you up.
adaptionwheel.desc.Mutation_Aquatic: Water becomes your element: far greater swim speed and underwater mining.
adaptionwheel.desc.Mutation_Impact: Hard landings unleash a shockwave that punishes everything around you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Lava: Heat cannot harm you anymore; lava swims like water.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Drowning: Your lungs no longer fail underwater.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Thorns: Spines, cacti and thorns deal you no harm.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Suffocate: Being buried inside blocks no longer crushes you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Void: Out-of-world space no longer erases you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Starve: Hunger can no longer starve your body.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Liquid: Water is home: swim at land pace and mine without penalty.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Ice: Ice grips others, but obeys you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Env_Slime: Slime blocks hold no bounce over you.
adaptionwheel.desc.Mutation_Thermal: Heat feeds regeneration instead of harm.
adaptionwheel.desc.Mine_Labor: Endless labor tempers the body: mining grows faster with every level.
adaptionwheel.desc.Combat_Cooldown: The wheel masters your rhythm: attack cooldown penalties fade, then vanish.
adaptionwheel.desc.Combat_ShieldLock: Axes can no longer knock your shield aside.
adaptionwheel.desc.Combat_SkillIssue: Arrows find their mark on their own — but only the target you actually missed. Shots into empty space still miss.
adaptionwheel.desc.Dimension_Destroy: Transcendence: Sword of Extermination swings tear three spatial rifts that sever up to five lives each.
adaptionwheel.desc.Percep_SteadyGaze: Pain no longer shakes your sight.
adaptionwheel.cmd.not_wearing: %s is not wearing the Mahoraga Wheel.
adaptionwheel.cmd.usage: Usage: /adaptionwheel <status | list [domain] | info <concept> | grant <concept> [level] | analyze <concept> | reset | registry>
adaptionwheel.cmd.usage_hint: Concept examples: Type_FIRE, Move_Honey, Mine_Labor, Combat_Cooldown, Contact_minecraft:zombie, Debuff_weakness
adaptionwheel.msg.instabreak_unlocked: INSTABREAK DECODED - toggle it with the Instabreak key in your controls
adaptionwheel.desc.Fist_Wood: Break soft blocks bare-handed and still collect them. Ore pays x1.
adaptionwheel.desc.Fist_Stone: Stone, sandstone, quartz and the deepslate family fall to the fist. Ore pays x2.
adaptionwheel.desc.Fist_Iron: The Nether band and everything an iron pickaxe mines. Ore pays x3.
adaptionwheel.desc.Fist_Diamond: The whole deepslate family, obsidian, crying obsidian, ancient debris, netherite blocks, lodestone. Ore pays x5.
adaptionwheel.desc.Fist_Netherite: Dragon eggs, spawners, reinforced deepslate. Ore pays x10.
adaptionwheel.desc.Mutation_Fist: Unlocked by maxing Labor and breaking a stone block bare-handed. Grants a tool-less fist that grows through five materials, 8 levels each, mining as fast as the matching tool and multiplying what ore drops. Netherite 8 decodes Instabreak.
adaptionwheel.msg.fist_material_hint: Break %s by hand to train it - %s blocks for the next level.
adaptionwheel.fist.material.Fist_Wood: dirt, sand, gravel, planks, logs, wool or terracotta
adaptionwheel.fist.material.Fist_Stone: stone, cobblestone, deepslate, sandstone, quartz, coal, copper, iron or lapis ore
adaptionwheel.fist.material.Fist_Iron: netherrack, basalt, blackstone, glowstone, magma, soul soil, or gold, redstone, diamond and emerald ore
adaptionwheel.fist.material.Fist_Diamond: deepslate, tuff, calcite, dripstone, obsidian, ancient debris, netherite blocks, or diamond and emerald ore
adaptionwheel.fist.material.Fist_Netheri: dragon eggs, spawners and reinforced deepslate
adaptionwheel.msg.fist_luck: LUCK x%s - that tier breaks ore %sx richer, experience included.
adaptionwheel.cmd.grant_level_ignored: %s is a one-time adaptation and has no levels; the number was ignored.
adaptionwheel.cmd.ungrant_absent: %s is not adapted on %s; nothing to remove.
adaptionwheel.cmd.use_registry: Run /adaptionwheel registry to see every adaptation.
adaptionwheel.cmd.looks_truncated: '%s' looks like a concept that was cut at a colon. Namespaced concepts must be quoted: /adaptionwheel grant "%s" <level>
adaptionwheel.msg.wheel_tier_next: Hold %s more adaptations to wake it further
adaptionwheel.config.wheelTiers.enabled: The wheel has tiers of its own. Each reveals another family of adaptations.
adaptionwheel.synergy.ashwalker.desc: Your attacks set the target alight.
adaptionwheel.synergy.glacierblood.desc: Your attacks slow whatever they land on.
adaptionwheel.synergy.drownedwaltz.desc: Submerged, you no longer need air and move faster still.
adaptionwheel.synergy.skybreaker.desc: Your landing shockwave is far larger and triggers from much lower.
adaptionwheel.synergy.unmaker.desc: Void damage heals you instead of hurting you.
adaptionwheel.synergy.unseen.desc: Mobs lose track of you far more quickly.
adaptionwheel.synergy.gravebloom.desc: Damage you take from a mob is partly returned to it.
adaptionwheel.synergy.goliath.desc: Your bare hand burns what it breaks, and cooks what it touches.
adaptionwheel.synergy.stormcall.desc: Your damage arcs to a second and third target.
adaptionwheel.synergy.astralmine.desc: Breaking blocks feeds your recovery, and the fist never slows.
adaptionwheel.cmd.shed_disabled: Shedding is disabled in the config.
adaptionwheel.cmd.shed_stillanalysing: %s is still being analysed -- wait for it to finish.
adaptionwheel.cmd.shed_duringadversity: Nothing may be shed during Adversity.
adaptionwheel.cmd.shed_woulddroptier: Shedding %s would cost you a whole family of adaptations. It is the last one you hold.
adaptionwheel.config.shedding.enabled: Players may shed an adaptation for a Wild Release burst.
adaptionwheel.config.shedding.releaseBas: Wild Release duration at level 1, in ticks.
adaptionwheel.config.shedding.releaseTic: Extra Wild Release ticks per level shed.
adaptionwheel.config.shedding.reattachTi: Fraction of the original timer a re-shed concept costs.
adaptionwheel.config.shedding.protectTie: Refuse a shed that would drop the player's wheel tier.
adaptionwheel.config.resonance.enabled: Adapted players within range strengthen each other.
adaptionwheel.config.resonance.particles: Draw a burst at a wearer's feet when their rung rises.
adaptionwheel.msg.transfer_nothing: You have nothing left that %s does not already have.
adaptionwheel.config.transfer.enabled: Right-clicking a player with the wheel hands them an adaptation.
adaptionwheel.msg.stone_no_wheel: The stone is inert. Wear the wheel.
adaptionwheel.msg.stone_nothing: The wheel has nothing left to show you here.
adaptionwheel.config.ritual.brazierHealE: The Adaptation Brazier heals a wheel-wearer nearby.
adaptionwheel.config.ritual.totemEnabled: The Wheel Totem advances running analyses nearby.
adaptionwheel.config.ritual.totemAcceler: Ticks removed per second, per totem.
adaptionwheel.config.ritual.altarEnabled: The Resonance Altar adds a rung nearby.
adaptionwheel.config.ritual.domainStoneE: The Domain Stone hands out an adaptation.
item.adaptionwheel.disciple_spawn_egg: Disciple of the Domain Spawn Egg
adv.adaptionwheel.root.title: Adaptation
adv.adaptionwheel.root.desc: Everything that happens to you, you will have already survived.
adv.adaptionwheel.wheel.title: The Wheel
adv.adaptionwheel.wheel.desc: Bind a Dharma Chakra to yourself.
adv.adaptionwheel.first_steps.title: First Adaptation
adv.adaptionwheel.first_skill.title: Adapt to Harm
adv.adaptionwheel.first_skill.desc: Suffer a kind of damage until it stops mattering.
adv.adaptionwheel.twenty.title: Twenty Things
adv.adaptionwheel.first_synergy.title: Combinations
adv.adaptionwheel.first_synergy.desc: Two adaptations that do more together. Press K to see which.
adv.adaptionwheel.resonance.title: Resonance
adv.adaptionwheel.resonance.desc: Stand near another adapted player, and be stronger for it.
adv.adaptionwheel.hundred.title: One Hundred
adv.adaptionwheel.hundred.desc: A hundred adaptations. The wheel is very far awake now.
adv.adaptionwheel.transcendent.title: Destroy the Dimension
adv.adaptionwheel.transcendent.desc: Hold enough adaptations that the wheel can cut a world open.
adv.adaptionwheel.first_contact.title: Adapt to a Mob
adv.adaptionwheel.first_contact.desc: One particular mob no longer worries you.
adv.adaptionwheel.first_offense.title: Adapt Against a Mob
adv.adaptionwheel.first_offense.desc: You have learned to answer one particular mob.
adv.adaptionwheel.first_plunder.title: Plunder
adv.adaptionwheel.first_plunder.desc: One particular mob gives considerably more.
adv.adaptionwheel.first_existence.title: Adapt to a Boss
adv.adaptionwheel.first_existence.desc: You have adapted to something that was going to kill you.
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_stirring.title: Stirring
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_stirring.desc: Contact. The wheel now learns about individual mobs.
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_resonant.title: Resonant
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_resonant.desc: Offense. You can turn a mob's own nature against it.
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_dominant.title: Dominant
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_apex.title: Apex
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_apex.desc: Existence. You adapt to the things that were going to kill you.
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_infinite.title: Infinite
adv.adaptionwheel.tier_infinite.desc: Everything there is to adapt to, you have adapted to.
adv.adaptionwheel.fist.title: Fist Mastery
adv.adaptionwheel.fist.desc: Adapt to breaking. Your bare hand learns to be a tool.
adv.adaptionwheel.fist_iron.title: An Iron Hand
adv.adaptionwheel.fist_iron.desc: Iron tier of the fist, learned from the blocks themselves.
adv.adaptionwheel.instabreak.title: Instabreak
adv.adaptionwheel.instabreak.desc: Nothing between you and the block.
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_thermal.title: Thermal Mastery
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_thermal.desc: Fire adapts to you, and you to fire.
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_aquatic.title: Aquatic Mastery
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_aquatic.desc: Water stops being somewhere you survive.
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_impact.title: Impact Mastery
adv.adaptionwheel.mutation_impact.desc: The ground answers when you land.
adv.adaptionwheel.mastery.title: Mutations
adv.adaptionwheel.mastery.desc: Three of the four combinations, and the fist.
adv.adaptionwheel.soe.title: Sword of Extermination
adv.adaptionwheel.skill_issue.title: Skill Issue
adv.adaptionwheel.skill_issue.desc: Your arrows go where they are aimed.
adv.adaptionwheel.adversity.title: Adapting to Adversity
adv.adaptionwheel.adversity.desc: Survive the thing the wheel sends.
adv.adaptionwheel.shed.title: Shedding
adv.adaptionwheel.shed.desc: Give an adaptation up on purpose, and take the burst.
adv.adaptionwheel.shed_ten.title: Ten Times Shed
adv.adaptionwheel.shed_ten.desc: Ten adaptations given up, and ten bursts taken.
adv.adaptionwheel.ritual.title: Ritual
adv.adaptionwheel.ritual.desc: The wheel's craft. Four blocks that only ever give.
adv.adaptionwheel.domain_stone.title: The Domain Stone
adv.adaptionwheel.domain_stone.desc: A stone that trades an item for an adaptation. The item is the price.
adv.adaptionwheel.disciple.title: Disciple Felled
adv.adaptionwheel.disciple.desc: Something that measures you has fallen.
adaptionwheel.gui.need_item: Put an offering item in the upper slot.
adaptionwheel.msg.stone_too_few: Not enough. The stone wants more.
adaptionwheel.msg.stone_stale: The stone has moved on. Look again.
adaptionwheel.msg.stone_no_experience: The stone asks %s levels. You have %s.
adaptionwheel.gui.all_learned: You have learned all this mob teaches.
